title: Semester Kickoff & Exploring Local LLMs
content:
### What I'm Learning
- Diving deeper into C++ memory management, templates, and DSA patterns for competitive programming.
- Experimenting with WebGL fragment shaders and Raymarching basics for procedural graphics.

### What I'm Building
- Re-architecting this personal portfolio and blog with SvelteKit 2 and Svelte 5 runes.
- Developing a local-first content admin tool powered by Tauri 2 and Rust.

### What I'm Reading
- *Designing Data-Intensive Applications* by Martin Kleppmann.
- Long-form essays on internet culture, software craftsmanship, and retro computing.

### Location & Mindset
- New Delhi / NSUT campus.
- Feeling energized by the arrival of autumn weather and fewer context switches.

title: Late Summer Hacking & Systems Programming
content:
